'''Nargo''' was a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]. He was widely known as unsympathetic.

Nargo set up a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] by having a group of "[[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]" (actually his employees) hijack the shipment of [[Tirefin]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] they were hauling, then attempted to force the smugglers to pay him back for the shipment he "lost."
